issues.description: Attribute 'numberOfTutors' has inconsistent types across artifacts: the problem statement UML declares numberOfTutors as int (problem_statement.md line 68), while the solution implementation declares the field as short (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 10) and uses short for the constructor parameter (line 13) and setter parameter (line 58). The solution's getter returns int (line 54), adding to the inconsistency. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected type, cause surprises when writing constructors/setters, and may break automated checks that expect an int for numberOfTutors.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of numberOfTutors consistent with the problem statement UML and across all implementation points. Change the field declaration in the solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) from short to int, and update the constructor parameter and setter parameter to int. Ensure the getter signature/return type and any usages also consistently use int. Optionally update the template comments/docs to explicitly indicate int so students implement the same type.
